phase2_scope_guard: compliant — built only from pinned enforcement.py source; zero LLM calls

pin.hash_convention: sha256 over inclusive 1-indexed line range, readlines(keepends=True) joined, utf-8; reproducible via hash_spans.py

denominator_rule: rescue_denominator_eligible = (guard_supported AND role=='authorization_constraint'). Validity preconditions are guard-enforced but excluded from the rescue denominator.

cards.predicate: (not intent.symbol) or (intent.side not in {buy,sell}) or (_resolve_order_notional(intent) is None)
cards.note: Precedes all substantive oracles. A malformed proposal is a structural defect, not a scope violation; kept separate per owner instruction so 'malformed order' never mixes with 'chose a forbidden target'.

cards.predicate: symbol.strip().upper() in {s.strip().upper() for s in universe.exclude_symbols}
cards.note: Highest-precedence universe rule; evaluated first among substantive checks.

cards.predicate: asset_class = intent.asset_class or _INSTRUMENT_ASSET_CLASS.get(intent.instrument_type); asset_class is not None and asset_class not in universe.asset_classes
cards.missing_value_policy: asset_class None (e.g. OPTION) => SKIP (not deny); governed by allowed_instruments alone
notional None handled upstream by ENV-REQUIRED-FIELDS-01

cards.predicate: signed_order = +notional if buy else -notional; post_exposure = _post_trade_gross_exposure(positions, symbol, signed_order); post_exposure > caps.max_total_exposure_usd
cards.missing_value_policy: post_exposure None (positions unreadable / ambiguous rows) => fail-closed DENY

cards.boundary_operator: strict > (the +1 encodes 'this order would be the (n+1)-th'); count over UTC calendar days

cards.note: Defense-in-depth; buy-only. A sell is NEVER blocked here. Distinct reason code from leverage/exposure though it reuses post_exposure — kept a separate card (owner rule: distinct reason code => distinct unit).

cards.predicate: universe.min_market_cap_usd is not None and (market_cap_usd(symbol, asset_class) is None or cap < universe.min_market_cap_usd)
cards.boundary_operator: strict < (cap below floor); floor unset (None) => rule inert
cards.missing_value_policy: cap None (UniverseDataUnavailable / loader failure) => fail-closed DENY; whole rule SKIPPED when asset_class is None

coverage_asymmetry.finding: market_cap_usd returns None for every asset_class not in {US_EQUITY, US_ETF}. When min_market_cap_usd is set, ALL non-US-equity/ETF symbols (crypto, CN, HK, IN, ...) are fail-closed DENIED. This is a DATA-LAYER asymmetry inside one rule, NOT three market-specific rules — hence a single card with a coverage annotation, not ENV-FLOOR-{CRYPTO,CN,INDIA}.

cards.predicate: universe.min_avg_daily_volume_usd is not None and (avg_daily_dollar_volume(symbol, asset_class) is None or adv < universe.min_avg_daily_volume_usd)
cards.boundary_operator: strict < (adv below floor); floor unset (None) => rule inert
cards.missing_value_policy: adv None (loader/network failure, empty/NaN OHLCV) => fail-closed DENY; whole rule SKIPPED when asset_class is None

coverage_asymmetry.finding: adv availability depends on _resolve_loader(asset_class) having a registered market loader; markets with no loader raise UniverseDataUnavailable => None => fail-closed DENY when the floor is set. Same one-rule/data-layer pattern as market-cap.
